claims.statement: Entered as no. 25 in the reconstructed catalogue of Leonardo's books, under Literature, Poetry and Fables. Leonardo's wording as rendered there: "Morgante".

claims.statement: Identified in the reconstruction as Il Morgante. The identification of a title in Leonardo's lists with a specific work and edition is an interpretation.
Composition and printing as given in the reconstruction: Composed 1460s to 1470s · Printed 1478, complete edition 1483.
